findings.summary: Complete amount messages force plural unit labels and a plural verb at value 1.
findings.cause: UsageSheet selects invariant localized unit labels and passes numeric 1 into complete messages; no unit inflection path exists. Context explicitly permits rephrasing to avoid invariant-label agreement.
findings.recommendation: Use a count-independent label structure, e.g. Restante ({unit}): {value, number}, Uso ({unit}): {value, number}, Restante: {value, number}. Keep existing named parameters and numeric ICU types. Alternatively introduce correctly inflected unit handling through a separately reviewed source change.
findings.severity_rationale: Repeated incorrect native complete messages at ordinary value 1 across three changed amount variants fail the explicitly requested agreement audit; this is a native-copy defect, not a wrong numeric amount or spend-permission bug.

findings.summary: Fixed a las is not grammatical when the formatted time is 1:00.
actual: Se restablece el 1 ene 2026 a las 1:00
findings.expected: Spanish time phrase is a la 1:00, not a las 1:00.
findings.recommendation: Avoid the time-dependent article with neutral timestamp punctuation, while preserving date medium/time short placeholders, e.g. Restablecimiento: {value, date, medium}, {value, time, short}.
findings.severity_rationale: Timestamp value stays correct and understandable; this is a narrow grammatical follow-up, not an independent blocker/major.

findings.summary: Native caché/tókenes choices are sound, but the source Spanish style guide still lists cache/token as kept-English.
findings.actual: i18n/style-guides/es.md:24-27 includes token and cache in the binding kept-English list; translator HANDOFF.md records adapted prose/measurement choices only in scratch.
findings.recommendation: Record the narrowly scoped Spanish prose caché and measurement-label tókenes decisions in the durable Spanish style guide when landing translations. Keep API tokens/identifiers byte-identical. No need to replace sound native wording with raw English.
findings.severity_rationale: Documentation consistency follow-up; no change to meaning, numeric rendering, or eligibility. This alone does not force another native round.
